# Domain modeling (Matt Pocock)

Sharpens a project's domain language and records it in a glossary and ADRs.

- Source: https://github.com/mattpocock/skills
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mattpocock/skills/main/skills/engineering/domain-modeling/SKILL.md
- Author: Matt Pocock
- License: MIT
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/domain-modeling-matt-pocock-49487364

While you design, Claude challenges terms that conflict with GLOSSARY.md, proposes precise names for vague ones, tests relationships with edge-case scenarios, and checks claims against the code. Resolved terms go into the glossary right away, kept free of implementation details. It offers an ADR only when a decision is hard to reverse, surprising without context and the result of a real tradeoff. Format guides for both files are included.

**Try asking:**
- "Help me pin down what 'account' means in this codebase"
- "We're designing subscriptions. Challenge my terms as we go"
- "Record an ADR for why we chose event sourcing for orders"
